task_name: Lumora Laboratories - Retail launch and paid social system
client_brief:
Six-product retail launch: one image standard across store and paid social

Lumora Laboratories is preparing six products for specialty retail and a rebuilt store page. The photographs currently do not read as one line: grade all six to one neutral white balance. We need the image foundations corrected and carried into editable launch material.

Scope
1. Retail product-page module: 6 named exports. The pack matches the named SKU. The approved benefit is readable: each module gives its product's name, active and concentration, cleared claim, size and price exactly as in lumora_skus.csv.
2. Retail launch carousel: 6 named exports. The sequence differentiates the products: each of the six pages features one product and pictures its photographed pack, in the order numbered in lumora_copy_approved.txt, with its name and its active and concentration as approved. The brand appears on the opening page as the approved wordmark, lumora_wordmark_approved.png.
3. Paid social creative: 3 named exports. The approved product claim is unchanged: the hero product ad features Lumora C-15 Brightening Serum, product 1 in lumora_copy_approved.txt, shown with its photographed pack, its name, active and concentration, claim and price; the range comparison sets out all six products, each pictured by its own photographed pack with its name, active and concentration and price; the benefit story tells the longest cleared claim, that of Lumora Retinal Renewal Night Serum, in full, with the product shown with its photographed pack, its name and its active and concentration. Every claim shown is its cleared claim, word for word. The shopping action is clear: one plain instruction to shop or buy, with no offer, discount or urgency added.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Where a product's approved active line gives no percentage, set that line, unchanged, as its concentration display. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Clinical dermo-cosmetic actives, direct to consumer plus a specialty chain counter rollout, based in Los Angeles, California.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Los Angeles, California; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: Lumora Laboratories is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Los Angeles, California, and this commission covers phase 2: skincare counter launch for the parent range.
brand_identity.audience: Women twenty eight to forty five, ingredient literate, who read the INCI list before the claim and treat whitespace and evidence as signs of seriousness.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Forty six to eighty dollars per SKU. Premium but not luxurious: near monochrome grounds, evidence led hierarchy, and a price that sits quietly beside the specification. Deliberately clear of both the fourteen dollar mass aisle and the two hundred and fifty dollar luxury counter, either of which would misread the clinical claim.

palette.name: Lab Ink
palette.usage: Product names, claims, prices and the shopping action, as the name, claim and price are set on lumora_counter_card.pdf; may also set the active concentration display; the fill or outline of a shopping button. Never a ground or panel, except the fill of a shopping button.

palette.name: Clean White
palette.usage: The ground of every output, as on lumora_counter_card.pdf. Never a type colour, except the label of a Lab Ink shopping button.

palette.name: Slate Grey
palette.role: mandatory where an INCI line or a size appears
palette.usage: INCI lines, sizes and the small brand line, as on lumora_counter_card.pdf, which also sets the active line in Slate Grey, so it may set the active concentration display. Never a ground, a panel, a product name or a claim.

palette.name: Mineral Mist
palette.usage: Only the specification panel behind the active and INCI lines, as on lumora_counter_card.pdf, solid or at 55% on Clean White, which renders #E8ECED. Never type, never the page ground.

palette.name: Clinical Blue
palette.role: mandatory wherever an active concentration appears
palette.usage: The 1 px rule the width of the column under the active concentration, and hairline rules, as the rule on lumora_counter_card.pdf. Never type, a ground, a panel or a button.

brand_identity.typography: Lumora Laboratories runs on Spectral for display and the IBM Plex pair for text, quoted at screen size. Step 01, display, is the active concentration in Spectral Medium 500 at 112 px on 118 px leading, tracked minus 10 units, hung flush left so the percent sign falls into the margin, above a 1 px Clinical Blue rule the width of the column. Step 02, subheading, is the product name in Spectral Medium 500 at 56 px on 62 px leading, tracked minus 5 units, which is exactly half the concentration and never more; the counter card sets the same row at 28 pt. Step 03, body, is the claim in IBM Plex Sans Regular at 32 px on 46 px leading, tracking zero, set to a maximum of 65 characters. Step 04, fine print, is the INCI line in IBM Plex Sans Regular at 16 px on 24 px leading tracked 10 units, set exactly as cleared. Every figure anywhere in the system, in a claim or in the fine print, sets in IBM Plex Mono Regular.
brand_identity.voice: Precise and evidence first, no hyperbole. Example line the brand would write: 'Formulated around actives, at concentrations we publish.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The wordmark is approved but exists only as a flat web scale PNG of the letterforms in one deep ink on white, exported by the founders' first designer, with no vector source on hand. The six products were photographed in house on a pale sweep across two sessions. The regulatory cleared INCI lines and claims are fixed and cannot be edited, and the specialty chain has supplied its approved counter card press file.
brand_identity.values: Clinical credibility earned through disclosure. Actives and concentrations named, nothing oversold.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: The active concentration is always the largest element on the surface, set in Spectral Medium at exactly twice the product name, hung flush left so the percent sign falls into the margin above a 1 px Clinical Blue rule.

type_system.text_face: IBM Plex Sans, with IBM Plex Mono for every figure

scale.note: Exactly twice the product name. Hung flush left so the percent sign falls into the margin, above a 1 px Clinical Blue rule the width of the column.
Always exactly half the concentration above it. The counter card sets this row at 28 pt.

scale.sample: Supports visible brightness and a more even-looking tone.
scale.note: Claim copy. Any figure inside a claim sets in IBM Plex Mono Regular.

scale.sample: Aqua, Ascorbic Acid, Propylene Glycol, Ferulic Acid, Tocopherol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Panthenol
scale.note: Regulatory cleared INCI, set as supplied. Figures in IBM Plex Mono Regular.

type_system.signature_move: The active concentration is always the largest element on the surface, set in Spectral Medium at exactly twice the product name, hung flush left so the percent sign falls into the margin, above a 1 px Clinical Blue rule the width of the column.
rules: Never let a product name outsize its concentration.
The concentration is always the largest element on the surface and always exactly twice the product name.
The concentration hangs flush left so the percent sign falls into the margin.
A 1 px Clinical Blue rule the width of the column always runs under the concentration.
Spectral Medium 500 sets the wordmark and product names only.
IBM Plex Sans Regular carries claims and INCI. IBM Plex Mono Regular carries every figure.
Cleared INCI lines and claims are fixed and cannot be edited.
The counter card name holds at 28 pt.

palette_rules.distribution: Clean White is the ground of every output. Type sits on Clean White or on the Mineral Mist specification panel, as on lumora_counter_card.pdf, or directly on a photograph with no scrim under it; the only Clean White type is the label of a Lab Ink shopping button. Product names, claims, prices and the shopping action are Lab Ink; INCI lines, sizes and the brand line are Slate Grey, as on lumora_counter_card.pdf; the active concentration display is Lab Ink or Slate Grey. A shopping button is Lab Ink with a Clean White label, or a Lab Ink outline with a Lab Ink label. Clinical Blue appears only as rules, the 1 px rule under each concentration included, and Mineral Mist only as the specification panel; neither is ever type.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, with one exception taken from lumora_counter_card.pdf: the specification panel behind the active and INCI lines may be Mineral Mist at 55% opacity on Clean White, which renders #E8ECED. No other tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the five palette hexes, or #E8ECED for the Mineral Mist panel at 55%, for type, panels, rules, buttons or icons, and no gold, silver, metallic or foil colour and no gradient effect in type, panels, rules, buttons or icons: the brand is premium but not luxurious and stands deliberately clear of the luxury counter. Photographs are governed by the photography rule. lumora_wordmark_approved.png keeps its own ink.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own product colour and are graded to one neutral white balance, never recoloured toward the palette: the amber glass in lumora_range_frame_01.jpg and lumora_range_frame_02.jpg stays amber, and no sweep is left or tinted toward Clinical Blue or Mineral Mist to match the design.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve approved copy, dimensions, hierarchy, and reproduction requirements; do not imply a data merge or editable system that is outside the scoped deliverables.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
